pages.title: Getting started
pages.summary: Run Willow on your own computer, sign in as the owner and finish setup.

pages.title: Your first day in Willow
pages.summary: Name your employer, add places, teams, schedules, leave policies and checklists, then invite your team.

pages.title: People and joiners
pages.summary: Start a joiner, schedule a change, record a leaver and keep each person's record and documents.

pages.title: Leave
pages.summary: Leave worked out in hours from each person's schedule, decided by their manager and kept in a ledger.

pages.title: Payroll handoff
pages.summary: Each pay period, hand your payroll provider exactly what changed, once, in the file layout it reads.

pages.title: Access and privacy
pages.summary: Who sees what: explicit permissions, what managers see, and how to preview exactly what anyone sees.

pages.title: Move in from BambooHR
pages.summary: Preview your BambooHR export before anything is written, apply it, and undo it if it is not right.

pages.title: Back up and restore
pages.summary: Export every table and document to one archive, keep it safe, and restore it into a fresh Willow.
